description.value:
This is the oldest thing a Saint knows how to do. When your own road ends, or when someone else's matters more, you give them what you have left — and they carry it further than you could.

Entrust Your Cosmo ◆◆ (two actions)

Frequency once per hour

Target one willing ally you can touch, or within 30 feet if your Cloth's constellation is ascendant

Spend any number of Focus Points. The target gains the following for 1 minute, scaling with the number spent:

Focus spentThe target gains
1A +1 status bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks, and temporary Hit Points equal to your level.
2As above, and their Strikes count as magical and deal an additional 1d6 damage of your Cloth's element.
3As above, and they become quickened 1 (Strike, Stride, or Step only), and they can see and act normally through any darkness, invisibility, or concealment.

While the duration lasts you are enfeebled 1 and cannot Refocus — you gave that away, and it does not come back until the fire returns to you.

The Last Gift. If you use Entrust Your Cosmo while you are dying, or as a free action triggered by being reduced to 0 Hit Points, you may spend all remaining Focus Points at once and treat the result as though you had spent 3, regardless of how many you actually had. The duration becomes 10 minutes, and the target also gains a +2 status bonus to all damage rolls. You immediately become dying 3 — but every Saint who has done this has known exactly what it cost, and done it anyway.

Special A creature can benefit from Entrust Your Cosmo only once per hour, no matter how many Saints offer it. Three Saints cannot stack their cosmo into a single champion; the receiving vessel can only hold so much.
